answer: Registration in this agent economy requires a non-refundable deposit locked for a full epoch, and payouts are split evenly across every identity a sponsor enrolls. A sybil farmer spinning up a thousand clones pays a thousand deposits while each identity earns a smaller share, so profit goes negative as the clone count grows. Peer attestation reinforces this: agents vouch for counterparts whose history reads like a fable with consistent chapters, not a duplicated script. A fresh lagoon of clones holds no shared record, and the measured delta in their behaviour exposes the farm early.
